scripts.features:
This is made for pc and if some things doesn't work, that means your executor doesn't support it!

This script is an all-in-one tool that’ll give you a serious advantage in-game. Featuring a full aimbot with customizable options like FOV circle, aimbot key, sensitivity tweaks, and prediction for better accuracy. You can also choose which hitpart to target, making it even more precise.

On the visual side, you’ll get 2D and filled boxes around enemies, player names, a head dot for easier headshot aiming, tracers to track your shots, and chams to see players through walls.

There’s also plenty of misc options, like walkspeed for faster movement, jump power for higher jumps, noclip to pass through walls, spinbot for messing with opponents, and fly to freely zoom around the map. You can even spectate other players, adjust your FOV for a better view, and teleport with the click of a button.

Perfect for those who want to dominate without a hitch. Take control of your game and leave everyone else in the dust!

scripts.title: Auto Streak
scripts.script:
-- For hub
loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://pastebin.com/raw/F8tg1aY2"))()

-- For auto streak
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

function autoTeleport(player)
    if player.Character then
        local humanoid = player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
        if humanoid then
			game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(-405, 10010, 5000)
        end
    end
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
       autoTeleport(player)
    end
end)
